items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Miles came up to me in the Vanguard. He wanted to get David to play in his band. So he asked me, he said, “How much should I pay him?”

ctx.x: Let me just take a break here.

(Elvin responds to a question. The question is not heard) Miles came up to me in the Vanguard. He wanted to get David to play in his band. So he asked me, he said, “How much should I pay him?” I said, “You pay him a thousand dollars a week you cheap ass mother!” I was just trying to sulk him.
So can one say that you remained a good relationship with Miles?
